The **Open Engineering Academy** teaches engineers how to design, build, and
operate declarative, composable systems using open technologies and hands-on
projects. It is the educational arm of the Open Engineering ecosystem.

## The academy story: compose → construct → behave

Open Engineering separates three genuinely different phases of engineering, and
the academy has one course per phase:

| Phase | Question | Course |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Compose** | *What should exist?* | [Crossplane](courses/crossplane/) |
| **Construct** | *How is it safely built?* | [Sandcastle](courses/sandcastle/) |
| **Behave** | *What does the resulting entity do?* | [Pico](courses/pico/) |

In short: **Crossplane composes, Sandcastle constructs, Picos behave.** Each
course teaches one layer; together they form a coherent path from declared
intent, through safely constructed artifacts, to long-lived reactive
behaviour.

## How the site is structured

The academy is a family of Quarto sites. This root site is the entry point and
directory; each course under `courses/` is published as its own self-contained
Quarto website with its own navigation, glossary, labs, and assets. Shared
templates, includes, and styling live under `templates/` and `shared/`.

Visit the canonical academy site at <https://academy.open-engineering.io>.
